title: Lock the Proof Strip composition
question: The mechanism stays fixed. Choose how strongly the real app should dominate the score → analysis → practice sequence.

options.label: Original Proof Strip
options.thesis: Four compact states carry equal narrative weight across one continuous reading line.
options.viewport: Score, live match, result, and Today read as a balanced sequence inside the first screen.
options.risk: The actual product may feel smaller than the mechanism explaining it.

options.label: Analysis-Dominant Hybrid
options.thesis: The imported score and measured feedback own the page; a compact Today panel proves where the result goes next.
options.viewport: Imported notation, played-note matching, timing, note length, and touch fill three quarters; Today occupies the final quarter.
options.risk: The analytics must stay truthful and legible without turning the landing page into a dashboard.

options.label: Score-Led Hybrid
options.thesis: The music itself becomes the causal line, with played notes and the next target flowing directly into Today.
options.viewport: A broad annotated score crosses into a large Today interface, with the next section beginning below.
options.risk: The score must stay credible and readable without overwhelming the product action.
